experiment_data.hypothesis: Cheetah Run baseline seed=4 extended to 300K. Tests whether eval drop at 194K→204K (537→302) is transient fluctuation or permanent collapse. Informs baseline stability and NVE normalization robustness.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 MUJOCO_GL=egl MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=0 python -u dreamer.py --configs defaults dmc_proprio --task dmc_cheetah_run --steps 300000 --seed 4 --device cuda:0 --compile False --gate_enabled False --checkpoint_every 10000 --logdir logdir/exp_023_cheetah_baseline_s4

metrics.note: 延长到 300K 确认非 collapse。eval 恢复到 642 peak@272K，200K-300K 区间震荡上行 (301-642 range)，194K→204K 骤降为 transient fluctuation。
